name: The bench
how: Drawn by Claude: a generator and a small isometric engine written for this round. Fixed stations on one straight belt (jointed arms, a C-frame press, a rail cart, a rover); the item travels.
trait: The camera follows the item through the middle steps.

name: The rails
how: Astra under a contract: the agents move and the item moves little. Three short fix passes from a located list.
trait: One long bench with machines on rails; the whole line in every frame.

name: The terraces
how: Gemini 4 Neon under a contract: the line climbs a stepped bench, with instrument-maker's machines. One fix pass after its own long polish loop.
trait: Progress reads as height; the camera follows the action.

name: Surprise me
how: Astra under an open brief: the fixed list and permission to choose everything else. Three short fix passes.
trait: A strip of the whole line over a large view of the station that acts.
